name: Veris Limited
summary: Veris Limited provides surveying, professional and advisory, and geospatial services in Australia. The company's Veris Australia segment provides cadastral, civil and construction, and engineering surveying, as well as 3D spatial services, such as lidar, 3D laser scanning, ground penetrating radar, mobile laser scanning, and hydrographic surveys. This segment also provides town planning and urban design services. It serves infrastructure, land and property, resources, and defence markets. Its Aqura Technologies segment offers ICT and communications services to the industrial communications sector. Veris Limited was formerly known as OTOC Limited and changed its name to Veris Limited in November 2016. Veris Limited is headquartered in Osborne Park, Australia.
